title: Simulation 3D Scene Configuration
text: Scene configuration for 3D simulation environment, {Name} sets Name of; {Scene source} sets the source of scene, {Scene name} sets the name of prebuilt 3D scene, {Project name} sets the name of Unreal Engine executable file, {Select ASAM OpenDRIVE file} sets an ASAM OpenDRIVE ® file, {Scene} sets the name of scene from executable file, {Project} sets the name of Unreal Engine project file or RoadRunner file valid project file, {Scene view} sets the placement of virtual camera that displays scene Scene, {Translation} sets the viewpoint translation, {Rotation} sets the viewpoint rotation, {Viewer relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the viewpoint translation relative to actor, {Viewer relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the viewpoint rotation relative to actor, {Sample time}, {Display 3D simulation window} sets the unreal Engine visualization, {Override scene weather} sets the option to control the scene weather and sun, {Sun azimuth} sets the azimuth angle from south to horizontal projection of the sun, {Sun altitude} sets the altitude angle between sun and horizon, {Enable geospatial sun} sets the option to enable geospatial sun, {Latitude}, {Longitude}, {Date (YYYY-MM-DD)} sets the date 2023-01-01, {Time (HH:MM:SS)} sets the time 10:30:00, {Time zone}, {Daylight saving time} sets the option to enable daylight saving time, {Cloud speed} sets the unreal Editor Cloud Speed global actor target, {Cloud opacity} sets the unreal Editor Cloud Opacity global actor target, {Enable volumetric clouds} sets the option to enable volumetric clouds, {Cloud coverage} sets the unreal Editor Cloud Density global target, {Cloud layer altitude} sets the unreal Editor Layer Bottom Altitude global actor target, {Fog density} sets the unreal Editor Set Fog Density and Set Start Distance target, {Rain density} sets the unreal Editor local actor controlling rain density, wetness, rain puddles, {Enable raindrops on camera lens} sets the option to enable raindrops on camera lens and {Snow density} sets the unreal Editor global actor controlling snow. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Scene source
params.values: Source of scene Default Scenes (default) | RoadRunner | Unreal Executable | Unreal Editor

params.name: Scene name
params.values: Name of prebuilt 3D scene Empty Grass | Straight road | Curved road | US city block | Large parking lot | installed scene name

params.name: Project name
params.values: Name of Unreal Engine executable file VehicleSimulation.exe (default) | valid executable file name

params.name: Select ASAM OpenDRIVE file
params.values: Specify an ASAM OpenDRIVE ® file off (default) | on

params.name: Scene
params.values: Name of scene from executable file /Game/Maps/HwStrght (default) | path to valid scene name

params.name: Project
params.values: Name of Unreal Engine project file or RoadRunner file valid project file name

params.name: Scene view
params.values: Placement of virtual camera that displays scene Scene Origin (default) | Custom | vehicle name | sim3d actor name | viewpoint name

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of custom viewpoint custom (default) | character array | string scalar

params.name: Translation
params.values: Viewpoint translation [0 0 0] (default) | real 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Rotation
params.values: Viewpoint rotation [0 0 0] (default) | real 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Viewer relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Viewpoint translation relative to actor [0 0 0] (default) | real 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Viewer relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Viewpoint rotation relative to actor [0 0 0] (default) | real 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time of visualization engine 1/60 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Display 3D simulation window
params.values: Unreal Engine visualization on (default) | off

params.name: Override scene weather
params.values: Option to control the scene weather and sun position off (default) | on

params.name: Sun azimuth
params.values: Azimuth angle from south to horizontal projection of the sun ray 90 (default) | any value between 0 and 360

params.name: Sun altitude
params.values: Altitude angle between sun and horizon 40 (default) | any value between -90 and 90

params.name: Enable geospatial sun
params.values: Option to enable geospatial sun off (default) | on

params.name: Latitude
params.values: Latitude of geolocation on earth 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Longitude
params.values: Longitude of geolocation on earth 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
params.values: Date 2023-01-01 (default) | integer

params.name: Time (HH:MM:SS)
params.values: Time 10:30:00 (default) | integer

params.name: Time zone
params.values: Time zone -5.0 (default) | any value between -12.0 and 12.0

params.name: Daylight saving time
params.values: Option to enable daylight saving time off (default) | on

params.name: Cloud speed
params.values: Unreal Editor Cloud Speed global actor target value 1 (default) | any value between -100 and 100

params.name: Cloud opacity
params.values: Unreal Editor Cloud Opacity global actor target value 10 (default) | any value between 0 and 100

params.name: Enable volumetric clouds
params.values: Option to enable volumetric clouds off (default) | on

params.name: Cloud coverage
params.values: Unreal Editor Cloud Density global target value 1.0 (default) | any value between 0 and 100

params.name: Cloud layer altitude
params.values: Unreal Editor Layer Bottom Altitude global actor target value 6 (default) | any value between 5 and 20

params.name: Fog density
params.values: Unreal Editor Set Fog Density and Set Start Distance target values 0 (default) | any value between 0 and 100

params.name: Rain density
params.values: Unreal Editor local actor controlling rain density, wetness, rain puddles, and ripples 0 (default) | any value between 0 and 100

params.name: Enable raindrops on camera lens
params.values: Option to enable raindrops on camera lens off (default) | on

params.name: Snow density
params.values: Unreal Editor global actor controlling snow density 0 (default) | any value between 0 and 100
